principle: Semantic porting to native Antoine/NATS trust boundaries; MAVLink payloads are not re-used.

scenarios.title: Camera Feed ROS Topic Flooding
scenarios.adaptation: Flood the configured camera transport
scenarios.gap: the partition-aware opt-in headless profile has no camera topic; ROS 2 transport is not launched

scenarios.title: Communication Link Flooding
scenarios.adaptation: 2–5 vehicle state-stream timing observation plus bounded wrong-callsign setpoint consumer-load sample
scenarios.gap: bounded wrong-callsign setpoint consumer-load sample is available; no network packet loss/delay injection, broker rate limiting, or general DoS result

scenarios.title: Denial-of-Takeoff
scenarios.adaptation: Withhold or corrupt local authority/setpoint before launch

scenarios.title: Flight Termination
scenarios.adaptation: Test authority revoke and neutralization behavior
scenarios.gap: one bounded timed revoke from the local demo signer; local stop latency only

scenarios.title: Geofencing Attack
scenarios.adaptation: Attempt to alter the mission boundary or navigation constraints
scenarios.gap: only if a configured geofence is enforced in this profile

scenarios.title: GPS Offset Glitching
scenarios.adaptation: Send bounded GPS offset/stale-state faults
scenarios.gap: signature mutation rejection is repeatable; same/older sequence and 501 ms-old/live-TTL ingress acceptance plus future timestamp non-acceptance are observed with run-local signatures; navigation freshness-use, rejection reason, and movement impact remain unmeasured

scenarios.title: Wifi Deauth Attack
scenarios.adaptation: Interrupt an attacker-owned local NATS client connection
scenarios.gap: no wireless network; do not disrupt shared broker

scenarios.title: Camera Feed Eavesdropping
scenarios.adaptation: Capture camera stream
scenarios.gap: a camera-only rehearsal proves same-host unauthenticated Gazebo Transport readability; remote, ROS 2, Wi-Fi, and GCS reachability are untested

scenarios.title: Flight Log Extraction
scenarios.adaptation: Collect per-run Antoine/Gazebo evidence and assess sensitive fields
scenarios.gap: run evidence is saved and exportable, but a dedicated log-extraction scenario and secret-redaction qualification are not catalogued

scenarios.title: FTP Eavesdropping
scenarios.adaptation: Capture FTP traffic
scenarios.gap: no FTP service in native profile

scenarios.title: Mission Extraction
scenarios.adaptation: Read the setpoints and mission metadata visible on NATS

scenarios.title: Parameter Extraction
scenarios.adaptation: Query controller parameters over a supported interface
scenarios.gap: no parameter service is currently wired into this proof profile

scenarios.title: ROS 2 Topic Replay
scenarios.adaptation: Replay captured NATS contract messages with stale sequence/time

scenarios.title: Wifi Client Data Leak
scenarios.adaptation: Inspect simulated wireless client data
scenarios.gap: no wireless lab in native profile

scenarios.title: Firmware Decompile
scenarios.adaptation: Inspect the compiled Rust SITL binary and recover exposed contracts/secrets
scenarios.gap: binary analysis only; private keys must never be embedded in the artifact

scenarios.title: Firmware Modding
scenarios.adaptation: Modify Rust controller source in an isolated research fork and compare its build identity
scenarios.gap: this is a supply-chain experiment, not an in-flight patch

scenarios.title: Camera Gimbal Takeover
scenarios.adaptation: Command a gimbal endpoint
scenarios.gap: no gimbal model/controller in the native profile

scenarios.title: Companion Computer Takeover
scenarios.adaptation: Compromise bridge process and test sensor provenance boundary
scenarios.gap: bridge is external; use a local test double, never the host service

scenarios.title: Companion Computer Web UI Login Brute Force
scenarios.adaptation: Attack companion web login
scenarios.gap: no native companion UI

scenarios.title: Flight Mode Injection
scenarios.adaptation: Attempt to change an unsupported mode/task through NATS
scenarios.gap: map only to modes/tasks Antoine actually exposes

scenarios.title: Ground Control Station Spoofing
scenarios.adaptation: Impersonate an authority or mission producer without its signing key

scenarios.title: MAVLink Injection Attack
scenarios.adaptation: Send malformed or unauthorized actuator/setpoint envelopes on NATS

scenarios.title: Return to Home Point Override
scenarios.adaptation: Attempt to replace the approved local return/mission target
scenarios.gap: depends on a native RTL behavior and approved task contract

scenarios.title: ROS 2 Rogue Publisher Injection
scenarios.adaptation: Publish unauthorized sensor data to Antoine's NATS input contract
scenarios.gap: setpoint publisher boundary is exercised; sensor contracts are not enabled by this launcher

scenarios.title: GPS Data Injection
scenarios.adaptation: Publish a forged or altered GPS envelope to the native sensor contract
scenarios.gap: the isolated opt-in sensor runner supports bounded probes, but standard swarm/baseline runs do not enable the sensor path; accepted freshness boundaries and navigation use remain unqualified

scenarios.title: Waypoint Injection
scenarios.adaptation: Publish unauthorized or mismatched NATS setpoints

scenarios.title: Companion Computer Discovery
scenarios.adaptation: Discover bridge/service role and reachable NATS subjects
scenarios.gap: legacy companion container is absent

scenarios.title: Drone Discovery
scenarios.adaptation: Discover local Gazebo model and NATS state subjects

scenarios.title: Drone GPS & Telemetry Detection
scenarios.adaptation: Observe the Gazebo-to-NATS state stream

scenarios.title: Ground Control Station Discovery
scenarios.adaptation: Discover local authority/controller endpoints and NATS subjects
scenarios.gap: no GCS in native profile

scenarios.title: Packet Sniffing
scenarios.adaptation: Observe NATS state, setpoint, and actuator subjects on the lab broker

scenarios.title: Protocol Fingerprinting
scenarios.adaptation: Fingerprint NATS server/client and message contracts

scenarios.title: ROS 2 DDS Graph Enumeration
scenarios.adaptation: Enumerate NATS subjects and Gazebo Transport topics
scenarios.gap: DDS graph is not the Antoine control plane

scenarios.title: Wifi Analysis & Cracking
scenarios.adaptation: NATS endpoint discovery and broker access review
scenarios.gap: native profile is loopback-only and has no simulated Wi-Fi

scenarios.title: Attitude Spoofing
scenarios.adaptation: Inject altered signed-state-shaped sensor data
scenarios.gap: it does not start the Nav sensor forwarder or pin sensor keys

scenarios.title: Battery Spoofing
scenarios.adaptation: Inject altered battery telemetry
scenarios.gap: the native profile has no battery telemetry producer/consumer contract

scenarios.title: Critical Error Spoofing
scenarios.adaptation: Inject synthetic health/error state
scenarios.gap: only if a consumed NATS health contract exists

scenarios.title: Emergency Status Spoofing
scenarios.adaptation: Forge or replay emergency/outcome data
scenarios.gap: distinguish telemetry display from authority-bearing veto

scenarios.title: GPS Spoofing
scenarios.adaptation: Publish forged or stale GPS input to the configured NATS sensor subject
scenarios.gap: signature mutation is rejected; valid run-local signatures passed same/older-sequence and 501 ms-old/live-TTL ingress; a +499 ms future sample produced no ingress trace; idealized GPS and test-only key

scenarios.title: Satellite Spoofing
scenarios.adaptation: Alter satellite-count input
scenarios.gap: satellite-count data is not consumed in the current native pipeline

scenarios.title: System Status Spoofing
scenarios.adaptation: Publish mismatched controller-health state
scenarios.gap: map to signed health and veto contracts

scenarios.title: VFR HUD Spoofing
scenarios.adaptation: Falsify flight telemetry presented to an operator
scenarios.gap: no native GCS/HUD
